prompt: Lifestyle photo of [PRODUCT] on [linen table/bathroom shelf/workbench], morning window light from the left, soft shadows, only one or two use-case props, slightly blurred background, product remains the clear focal point, label readable.

instructions.en: Use an original or licensed reference image when the prompt calls for one.
instructions.zh-Hans: 如提示词需要参考图，请使用原创或已获许可的素材。

visualReview.notes: Desktop detail and collection display checked; text and brand fidelity remain manual checks.
